waits: C3 widget-standards extraction has not landed (wayfinder/tickets/C3-widget-standards.md, output wayfinder/WIDGET-STANDARDS.md). This roster does not rename ids ahead of that document.
The device-family field face is field-lines so the encounter spine can keep the plain name field. If the standards document calls that face field, reconcile the two names then.
Skill pictures are the geometric stand-ins in agent-shell-mockup.html. The Expressions glyph library is their intended later source. Replace a picture with a chip; keep the skill id.
Bee portraits stay illustrations. They carry each agent's own colour, which this roster does not bake in.
Planet bodies stay the Earth projection's drawing. M0′–M5′ stay the mockup's text labels.
alignment_with_widget_standards: Ids use the mockup's control words: play, stop, record, arm, loop, session, arrangement, the five mode ids, clip, device, panes, admit, deny, hold, hand-back, steer, effort, folded, expand, pop-out.
The data-i pattern stays on the control: Name|what it does, read into the status line. Every use also has an aria-label. glyphs.ts refuses an empty label.

Shell colour tokens are packages/live-shell/ui/src/styles.css. Paper tokens are the document tokens in world-shell-mockup.html (--paper, --ink, --pmid, --pfaint, --prule). Glyphs reference neither by name; the element sets color.
Refusing, disabled, and waiting are separate marks at full weight, for the empty, refusing, and disabled states the standards ticket asks every widget to specify.
When WIDGET-STANDARDS.md names a widget, that name is the glyph id to follow.

evidence.shows: Every mark at 16, 20, and 24 in the shell theme and the paper theme, plus the six chip examples.
